Choose a backpack around what you carry

Check the laptop compartment separately

The overall liter capacity does not tell you whether a laptop fits. Measure the computer, including any protective sleeve, and compare the compartment dimensions and opening. A roomy main compartment can still have a narrow device pocket. For commuting, put a loaded water bottle, charger and lunch box into your space plan rather than choosing by the laptop-size headline alone.

Think about the journey with the bag loaded

Compare strap adjustment, back padding, access to tickets and whether the bag stands securely when opened. Water-resistant fabric is not a promise of waterproof seams or zippers. A travel backpack also needs to fit your airline's current personal-item limit; check the packed dimensions. Choose organization you will use, since extra pockets can take space away from bulky clothing.

How we choose these daily picks

Our product comparisons are built using current retailer data, market analysis and available marketplace feedback to identify the products most worthy of consideration. We do not rely on promotional messaging, manufacturer claims or advertised discounts when making recommendations. Instead, we focus on products that demonstrate strong value, positive seller signals and a credible marketplace track record. Although we have not physically tested every item featured, our methodology is designed to help consumers make informed and confident purchasing decisions. Where performance, safety or durability are especially important, we also encourage checking independent reviews of the exact model.
